result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where the bottom navigation bar lacks safe-area padding, causing the iOS home indicator to overlap the navigation icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar icons (especially the Search and Orders/Receipt icons) are overlapped by the iOS home indicator bar at the bottom of the screen due to missing bottom safe-area padding.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area inset padding to the bottom navigation bar so the navigation icons sit cleanly above the system home indicator.
